🚨 If you have 3–5 years of experience and still preparing basics… you’re already behind.
I went through advanced Data Engineer interview questions…
 and the level is NOT what most people expect.
👉 It’s not about tools.
 👉 It’s about how you think.
📌 (These are exactly the expectations mentioned in the guide — page 1)
🔥 REAL questions asked at top companies:
💥 1. “Your SQL query is slow in production. What do you do?”
✔️ Check execution plan (EXPLAIN)
 ✔️ Identify full scans / bad joins
 ✔️ Add indexes + partitioning
 ✔️ Reduce data scanned
👉 Not just SQL… performance mindset
💥 2. “How do you handle data skew in joins?”
✔️ Detect skewed keys
 ✔️ Use salting technique
 ✔️ Pre-aggregate data
 ✔️ Broadcast smaller tables
👉 This is where most candidates fail.
🔥 Reality Check:
If your answers sound like:
 ❌ “I used Spark, Airflow, SQL…”
